note:
Targeted repair of POT1-four-column_01, which Malcolm chose for the FAQ column on composition.

The fault: the second jar from the top is PINK but carries the Matrixyl label. Matrixyl's jar is neutral frosted white, so that is a wrong product colour, and it leaves two pink jars in a four-jar stack. Its wording reads MATIXYI 3000 PRO COLLAGEN / FULL & FIRNING TREATMENT / PREMIUM FORMLLA. The third jar reads PDRN COLLAGEEN REPAR. The top jar's fine line reads NIGHT CHERM.

Why repair rather than re-roll: across 42 candidates this session, composition proved the thing that could not be instructed reliably and text proved the thing that could. Re-rolling for correct text loses the arrangement Malcolm picked. So the chosen frame is its own reference and everything except the wording and that one jar's glass colour is described as unchanged - an edit prompt that mentions only the fix invites the model to re-stage the shot.

The white Matrixyl jar packshot is supplied as a second reference so the corrected jar has a real source for its colour and label rather than being described into existence.
